game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before skeleton miners overload Moss Door Chamber.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Archive variation 4: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Portability.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Infinite Loop Trap' (Week 4 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Moss Door Chamber'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
